integrity: The curve-specific results are proved analytically; deterministic finite computations corroborate but are not substitutes for the proof. No independence of external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer n>=3 and fixed positive rolling radius; independent arclength-uniform curve points, neither area nor angle sampling. Independent historical priority and mathematical audit are not established.
title: Sharp cusp-diameter laws and parity-dependent sample extremes of hypocycloids
